assumptions: Initial sampled edge asserts reset; subsequent resets are unconstrained and cancel target obligations.
Caller launches only when ready, consumes only valid results, and never kills an irrevocable uncached load.
Launched descriptors use legal RV32I load sizes/signs and are aligned unless already faulted.
Issue permission, head validity and full head identity remain unconstrained, including after a request is offered. No target or sink fairness or finite stall bound is assumed.
environment: Independent single-outstanding target ledger captures the external request_valid && request_ready handshake and its packet. It never reads DUT state or response_ready to schedule a response.

Responses may arrive on any later sampled edge, including the first eligible edge. ID and payload class come from the accepted packet; status may be OK or access fault. Successful payload bytes are arbitrary within legal lanes; access-fault data is zero.
The target retires its obligation when it presents the response; a separate assertion requires DUT readiness to equal outstanding ownership. Duplicate requests are asserted against, not assumed away.
All properties use clocked immediate assertions and explicit history registers. Reset suspends traffic properties and clears the ledger; legal traffic must never raise fatal.
claim: Depth-20 bounded load-request stability and external handshake ownership smoke under a legal target. Not induction, complete load verification, malformed-response/fatal recovery proof, data correctness, C++ memory safety, production integration, or full-core formal acceptance.
